newsitem.title: CHINA: China to check assets of credit cooperatives.
newsitem.headline: China to check assets of credit cooperatives.

text.p: China's Ministry of Finance and the People's Bank of China have issued a circular to check the assets of urban and rural credit cooperatives, the Financial News said on Wednesday.
The task would be finished by the end of this year, it quoted Vice Finance Minister Zhang Youcai as telling a meeting.
China last year ordered a streamlining of credit cooperatives, merging dozens of small cooperatives in each various into larger financial institutions based in major cities and provincial capitals.
